title: Xdrip with big diferences from finger BG + Treatments on NightScout
symptom: The user reports large differences between Libre readings via Blucon and fingerstick BG measurements, which became noticeable with recent versions. Also, when entering a finger reading in xDrip, treatments do not appear in NightScout reports, whereas entries via AndroidAPS are identified.
fix: The user reinstalled xDrip, imported the database, and imported the initial settings backup from when they switched to the Samsung, after which it worked great.
evidence_quote: Yesterday, i reinstall Xdrip, import Database and import the inicial settings backup that i have when i change to the Samsung. At the moment is working great!
